description: Maintained daily culinary operations of multiple local properties, cooking for private client and multiple guests in multiple homes. Utilized indepth knowledge of nutrition & communicated with healthcare professionals to optimize nutrition for desired health outcomes.

Oversaw domestic & international food production. Acquired wild & foraged foods. Hired, fired & trained staff at multiple international estates. Conducted extensive parties and charitable events; managed all facets of culinary event logistics. Maintained food service and provisions for private aircraft.

Nutrition, diet & recipe planning including for cancer patients, cardiac patients, and people with chronic diseases including Hepatitis C, Crohn's, & Hashimoto's. Taught diet, nutrition & cooking classes and smart consumer classes. Taught cooking and food science classes to children. Assisted with planning and creation of multiple community and school gardens.

Served on opening team for $800 million hotel; responsibilities included trouble-shooting culinary work flow, equipment needs, permitting & inspections, internal audits of health and safety, assessments of ingredients to minimize production waste and control inventory. Sourced ingredients, specializing in fresh and local.
Designed and implemented seasonal banquet menus. Transformed kitchen culture from one of pre-packaged food to scratch cooking.
Shepherded of 160 Montadale sheep, included: all care of animals, pasture management and animal husbandry. Management of organic market garden.
Operated wood-fired kitchen equipment including oven, grill and spit.

certifications.name: Leader of Chef's Collaborative, Catered events including Spotlight on Hudson Valley cuisine
Food anthropology and Charcuterie Study in Spain

matchmaking_summary: The candidate is a classically trained chef with significant experience managing daily culinary operations, nutrition optimization, and event planning. His portfolio includes working for multiple high-end clients including celebrities, executives, and investors, demonstrating expertise in discretion and privacy. The candidate has led and contributed to various projects ranging from private household management to large-scale catering events, showcasing versatility and adaptability.
